Soal #14: On automated inventory valuation (FIFO) in Odoo 19, which account is credited
upon Goods Receipt before vendor bill arrives?

params.name: OptText_B
params.text: Stock Interim Account (Received) — Kunci Jawaban Resmi ✓

params.name: Explanation Text
params.text:
💡 Pembahasan Vokal: Pada saat penerimaan barang (Goods Receipt), jurnal otomatis mendebit Persediaan
dan mengkredit Akun Stock Interim (Received) hingga tagihan vendor (Vendor Bill) direkonsiliasi.
